description: This file defines an abstract base class for Drupal options field types, providing methods for managing allowed values, options, and storage settings, as well as handling form interactions and AJAX operations.

classes.name: ListItemBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for Drupal options field types, providing core functionalities for managing options, storage, and form interactions.

methods.name: defaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Returns default storage settings, including allowed values and function.

methods.name: getPossibleValues
methods.description: Retrieves all possible values, flattening grouped options.

methods.name: getPossibleOptions
methods.description: Returns possible options, alias for getSettableOptions.

methods.name: getSettableValues
methods.description: Retrieves settable values, flattening grouped options.

methods.name: getSettableOptions
methods.description: Gets options allowed for setting based on field definition and entity.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample value based on allowed options.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the field value is empty.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for storage settings, including allowed values management.

methods.name: addMoreSubmit
methods.description: Handles adding a new option row in the form.

methods.name: addMoreAjax
methods.description: AJAX callback to add a new option row dynamically.

methods.name: deleteSubmit
methods.description: Handles removal of an option row.

methods.name: deleteAjax
methods.description: AJAX callback for deleting a row.

methods.name: allowedValuesDescription
methods.description: Abstract method to provide description of allowed values.

methods.name: validateAllowedValues
methods.description: Validates the allowed values list in the form.

methods.name: extractAllowedValues
methods.description: Extracts key-value pairs from allowed values input.

methods.name: validateAllowedValue
methods.description: Checks if a candidate value is valid.

methods.name: allowedValuesString
methods.description: Creates string representation of allowed values for editing.

methods.name: storageSettingsToConfigData
methods.description: Converts storage settings to configuration data.

methods.name: storageSettingsFromConfigData
methods.description: Converts configuration data back to storage settings.

methods.name: simplifyAllowedValues
methods.description: Simplifies structured allowed values to key-value array.

methods.name: structureAllowedValues
methods.description: Creates structured array from key-value allowed values.

methods.name: castAllowedValue
methods.description: Casts a value to the appropriate type.

methods.name: submitFieldStorageUpdate
methods.description: Resets static cache on storage update.
